name: Hardware Corner Mar 2026: RTX 3090 Qwen3 8B (Q4_K) prefill @ 32k ctx
methodology: THIRD-PARTY LAB MEASURED (Hardware Corner per-GPU LLM benchmark page, Updated Benchmarks: March 2026). llama.cpp, single RTX 3090 (24 GB GDDR6X). Context length is the KV depth the table column names. Token Generation column = batch-1 per-request decode tok/s, NOT aggregate across concurrent requests. Prompt Processing column = prefill tok/s at that context depth. The page does not publish the llama.cpp build hash, CUDA version, or exact prompt and output token counts beyond the context-depth bucket.
notes: format_id is the nearest standard GGUF in this repo; the page labels the quant as shown in the model field. Single card, weights fully in VRAM. A dash in the source table means the context did not fit and is not recorded.
